challenge.method: I compared the exact July 2013 cover and summary to the independent Working Group and steering body records and the covers of the two post-ratification copies and the R6RS report.
challenge.results: The Working Group attachment is the authorized original. Its summary expressly names Scheme, static scope, proper tail recursion and its Lisp dialect status. The Working Group names its report R7RS-small. The two differently hashed 2021 PDFs and separate 2007 report establish comparison boundaries.

limitations: The evidence establishes the declared Scheme identity and July 2013 R7RS-small profile. Other reports, Lisp dialects and implementation compatibility have separate scope.
